wholePhysicalScope: OSM relation 17080654 records the two connected museum-period volumes, five open courts, Janpath entrance and the mapped sculpture court fountain.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain both exterior volumes, the mapped entrance and open courts. Near views refine stone bands, the curve of the sculpture court and its glass, columns, fountain and paving.
limitations: The outer facade details, modeled roof services and exact entrance arrangement are estimates based on open map controls and written building information. The public-domain image directly documents the circular courtyard.
The sculpture plinths are schematic and the collection, staff areas and gallery interiors are outside the exterior model. Finished grades use the original composite elevation field.

The original elevation surface crosses the mapped circular court and low side facades. The viewer clears terrain only within the native court boundary, and neither the field nor grades outside the court were altered.
